raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: MDAnalysis
  version: "2.11.0"
  sha256: aee95dc08d55169c58adbeb2980ff4a39b153bf85f55f291c6c0f7b8226223b0

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/m/mdanalysis/mdanalysis-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: ${{ sha256 }}

build:
  number: 1
  skip: match(python, "<3.11,>3.14")
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cython
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: numpy
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - numpy ${{ numpy }}.*
    - cython
    - packaging
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python
    - scipy >=1.5.0
    - numpy >=1.26.0
    - matplotlib-base >=1.5.1
    - if: not ppc64le
      then: seaborn
    - netcdf4 >=1.0
    - if: not match(python, ">3.12")
      then: biopython >=1.80
    - networkx >=2.0
    - griddataformats >=0.4.0
    - joblib >=0.12
    - gsd >3.0.0
    - mmtf-python >=1.0.0
    - scikit-learn
    - tidynamics >=1.0.0
    - tqdm >=4.43.0
    - threadpoolctl
    - filelock
    - packaging
    - h5py >=2.10.0
    - if: not ppc64le
      then: pytng >=0.2.3
    - pyedr >=0.7.1
    - mda-xdrlib
    - gemmi >=0.7.5
    - pooch

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - MDAnalysis
        - MDAnalysis.analysis
        - MDAnalysis.lib.c_distances_openmp
        - MDAnalysis.lib.c_distances
      pip_check: false

about:
  license: LGPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: A Python package for the handling and analysis of molecular simulations data.
  description: |
    MDAnalysis is a Python library to analyze trajectories from molecular
    dynamics (MD) simulations. It can read and write most popular formats, and
    provides a flexible and fast framework for writing custom analysis through
    making the underlying data easily available as NumPy arrays.
  homepage: https://www.mdanalysis.org
  repository: https://github.com/MDAnalysis/mdanalysis
  documentation: https://docs.mdanalysis.org/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - hmacdope
    - kain88-de
    - orbeckst
    - richardjgowers
    - ialibay
